items.title_cn: 消息称希捷与东芝竞购 TDK 硬盘磁头业务，争夺 AI 存储供应链关键环节
items.title_en: Report: Seagate and Toshiba bid for TDK's hard drive head business, vying for a key link in the AI storage supply chain
items.title_original: 消息称希捷与东芝竞购 TDK 硬盘磁头业务，争夺 AI 存储供应链关键环节
items.what_happened: 据彭博社报道，希捷科技控股与东芝正在争夺 TDK 的硬盘磁头业务，两家竞争对手都希望跟上 AI 数据中心存储设备的旺盛需求。知情人士称，东芝于今年春季率先与 TDK 开启收购谈判，希捷随后在夏季提出更高报价，交易价值最高可达数十亿美元。TDK 是全球唯一独立生产硬盘磁记录磁头的制造商，磁头是硬盘内实际完成数据读写的零部件，TDK 同时向希捷、东芝和西部数据供货。希捷和西部数据可自行生产部分磁头，但需求激增时仍需依靠 TDK；东芝则完全依赖 TDK，并计划大规模量产热辅助磁记录（HAMR）大容量硬盘。上周三家企业高管已在东京会面讨论保障供应，包括设立合资公司的可能性；谈判仍处初步阶段，交易存在破裂可能。无论哪方完成收购，都需接受反垄断审查。根据集邦咨询数据，按存储容量计，希捷与西部数据各占约 45%，东芝约占 10%。
items.what_happened_en: According to Bloomberg, Seagate Technology Holdings and Toshiba are competing to buy TDK's hard drive head business, as both rivals seek to keep up with strong demand for AI data center storage. People familiar with the matter said Toshiba began acquisition talks with TDK in the spring, and Seagate made a higher offer in the summer; the deal could be worth up to several billion US dollars. TDK is the world's only independent maker of hard drive magnetic recording heads, the component that performs data reads and writes, and it also supplies Seagate, Toshiba and Western Digital. Seagate and Western Digital can make some heads themselves but still rely on TDK when demand surges, while Toshiba depends entirely on TDK and plans to mass-produce HAMR high-capacity drives. Last week executives of the three companies met in Tokyo to discuss securing supply, including a possible joint venture; talks are still preliminary and could fall apart. Any deal would face antitrust review. According to TrendForce, by storage capacity Seagate and Western Digital each hold about 45% of the hard drive market and Toshiba about 10%.
items.why_it_matters: 掌控唯一独立磁头供应商将影响 AI 数据中心存储供应链的定价权与产能。
items.why_it_matters_en: Control of the only independent head supplier would shape pricing power and capacity in the AI data center storage supply chain.

items.title_cn: 华为余承东谈内存压力：每部手机成本大增 200 美元，为保公司生存不得不涨价
items.title_en: Huawei's Yu Chengdong on memory pressure: each phone costs over $200 more, prices must rise to keep the company alive
items.title_original: 华为余承东谈内存压力：每部手机成本大增 200 美元，为保公司生存不得不涨价
items.what_happened: 10 月 6 日，华为海外 X 账号发布 9 月 29 日国际媒体圆桌会议摘要。华为常务董事、终端 BG 董事长余承东表示，内存组件价格急剧上涨导致每部手机额外增加超过 200 美元（约合 1,343 元人民币）成本，因华为手机内存配置更高，成本上涨更多。他说许多手机制造商在提高价格，华为以非常缓慢的速度涨价并试图自己承担成本，但整体利润率正急剧下降，未来“也不得不提高价格”，否则业务无法持续。他还提到，智能手机涨价后低端市场将更受压，推动厂商向中端和高端市场移动，而高端市场是华为擅长的领域；在欧洲等市场手机主要通过电信公司销售，华为若想在一些发达国家卖出更多手机，就必须回归电信转售渠道。
items.what_happened_en: On October 6, Huawei's overseas X account published a summary of a September 29 international media roundtable. Yu Chengdong, Huawei's executive director and chairman of the terminal BG, said the sharp rise in memory component prices adds more than $200 (about 1,343 yuan) to the cost of each phone, and more for Huawei because its phones have higher memory configurations. He said many phone makers are raising prices, Huawei has raised prices very slowly and tried to absorb costs itself, but its overall profit margin is falling sharply, and "we will also have to raise prices" because the business cannot continue if it suffers losses. He added that higher smartphone prices will pressure the low-end market and push vendors toward mid- and high-end segments, where Huawei is strong, and that in markets such as Europe phones are mainly sold through telecom carriers, so Huawei must return to telecom resale channels if it wants to sell more in some developed countries.
items.why_it_matters: 内存成本上涨正在重塑手机定价，并推动厂商转向中高端市场与运营商渠道。
items.why_it_matters_en: Memory cost inflation is reshaping phone pricing and pushing vendors toward mid- and high-end segments and carrier channels.

items.title_cn: 为防范 AI 深度伪造，意大利总理梅洛尼申请将自己的声音注册为商标
items.title_en: To guard against AI deepfakes, Italian PM Meloni applies to register her voice as a trademark
items.title_original: 为防范 AI 深度伪造，意大利总理梅洛尼申请将自己的声音注册为商标
items.what_happened: 据路透社报道，公开档案显示，意大利总理焦尔吉娅·梅洛尼已向欧盟知识产权局（EUIPO）提交申请，希望将自己的声音注册为商标，以防范 AI 生成的深度伪造内容。申请日期为 10 月 5 日，其办公室已证实；申请附一段 4 秒录音，她用意大利语重复两遍“我是焦尔吉娅·梅洛尼”。该申请仍处审核阶段。意大利媒体报道称，即便获准，单凭该商标权仍无法完全阻止他人利用其语音制作 AI 深度伪造音频，但能给造假者增设法律障碍。2024 年梅洛尼已就一名撒丁岛男子用其面部生成并发布深度伪造色情图片提起民事诉讼，案件仍在意大利法院审理。
items.what_happened_en: According to Reuters, public records show Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has filed an application with the EU Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO) to register her voice as a trademark to guard against AI-generated deepfakes. The application is dated October 5 and was confirmed by her office; it includes a 4-second recording in which she repeats in Italian twice, "Io sono Giorgia Meloni." The application is still under review. Italian media report that even if granted, the trademark alone cannot fully stop others from using her voice to make AI deepfake audio, but it can add legal obstacles for counterfeiters. In 2024 Meloni already filed a civil suit against a Sardinian man over deepfake pornographic images using her face, a case still before Italian courts.
items.why_it_matters: 为以商标法应对 AI 语音深度伪造提供先例，法律效果有限但具体。
items.why_it_matters_en: It sets a precedent for using trademark law against AI voice deepfakes, with limited but concrete legal effect.
